title: Final Bot Plant capacity without production efficiency research
setup: Isolated in-memory engine fixture with an enlarged sector, adequate reserves and local wiring installed before game time advances. Proposal component recipe times with the same fixed 40-second Final Bot target as the ranked test. Production efficiency and both Lake Intake rate upgrades are absent. Current access research, Train logistics and Fines Recovery are active. Standard recipes and 100 ms simulation ticks.
topology: Reserve one Train per shared solid material and connect simple single-source paths directly. Put both base-rate Lake Intakes on the same Lake and feed their output into the Water tank. Use a separate Coolant tank.

Merge the three Copper Slurry outputs and split them to nine Controller Fabricators and the Circuit B Fabricator. Filter every Controller output. Feed Metallic Fines to the Waste Bin and Recycler, then return the recovered Iron Plate to its Train ahead of the primary Smelters.
Wire shared Iron Plate to Basic Gun and Cooled Gun first, shared Copper Wire to Basic Gun, Circuit B and Copper Slurry first, and shared Circuit A to Circuit C and Focused Gun first.

Keep Final Frame and Final Cannon trains dedicated. Fill each Bot Plant socket to five and each final-part Train to at least fifteen before starting the 40-second recipe. Collect finished bots in a separate Train.
bottlenecks: The 404-node supply estimate produced seven bots in 40 measured minutes. Six refiners delivered 90 Copper Wire per minute against the 108.75 target, despite a full Copper Plate pool.
Additional Copper mining, smelting, Wire refining and fuel recovered Wire supply. The shared Iron Plate feed then starved Circuit A and Circuit C, holding back Final Cannons.

Extra Wood, Charcoal and Iron capacity plus Circuit A feed priority restored the cannon chain. Added one Mythril Frame, one Servo Frame and one Final Frame Fabricator to support the frame branch during warm-up and operation.
limits: The run verifies this 40-minute measurement window. Cannon stock fell by one over the window. Terrain fit, construction, player interaction, reserve replenishment, cross-sector freight and minimum factory size remain outside the measurement.
